behaviors.description: Identify the controlled sandbox's initial process and its relationship to the application and outer supervisor.
behaviors.preconditions: Normal DO_NOT_REAP launches in dedicated PID namespaces held alive until explicit release; public procfs exposes NSpid, PID namespaces, executable bytes and ancestry.
behaviors.expected: Child PID becomes positive and identifies namespace PID 1 on the host; the deployed probe runs in that namespace with ancestry through the child PID to the outer PID; release ends both instances and child watches confirm successful exit.

behaviors.preconditions: CLI launches independent runtime probe and reports instance ID; probe confirms execution before inspection.
behaviors.expected: Exactly that live instance reports NULL app, expected runtime and runtime commit; sandbox is explicitly killed and reaped.

mappings.rationale: Synchronized child PID identifies the host-visible sandbox init (namespace PID 1), with ancestry to the outer PID. A distinct process in the same PID namespace matches the deployed probe bytes and descends from that init. Explicit release ends the instances and caller child watches confirm successful exit.
Synchronized actual runtime sandbox selected by launch-reported instance ID has NULL application getter.
